shared_elements: upright figures on a horizontal base/support
justification: Both depict upright human figures, and in each case the figures stand on or rise from a horizontal supporting element (a boat hull in A, a stepped platform in B), but that is a near-universal correspondence. A shows two flat, wholly schematic silhouette figures with no attributes inside a curved-ended vessel, while B shows a single richly costumed, naturalistically modelled figure with elaborate headdress, ornaments and glyph-like panels covering the shaft — utterly different conventions of depiction and content.
